name: net_session_config_dialog_init_map_name_strings
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::InitMapNameStrings constructs the static CString list of multiplayer map names. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The rebuilt source uses manual CString storage to keep the generated static initializer and cleanup functions explicit and testable.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c990 validates seven CString(const char*) constructions at g_NetSessionConfigDialog_MapNameStrings offsets 0..6 with literals RiverWorks, Crater Chaos, Beach Rally, Clone City, Frozen Tundra, Poison Valley, and New Clone City.
The native smoke calls InitMapNameStrings, verifies all seven constructed CString contents in order, and destructs the test strings afterward.
